# About
Updates aquatic biomes, adding blocks and a new mob!
This mod now adds a parrotfish and everything related to it, such as white sand!
The coral reefs are now more lively, but also more noisy. We hope you can come up with something with a parrotfish and new blocks.

Detailed information can be found in the spoiler.

# For Modpack Creators
You are free to use our mod in your modpacks. 
However, if you're making a **paid** modpack, you'll need to **ask** our permission

# Features
<details>
<summary>Parrotfish</summary>
Parrotfish is a new tropical fish that spawns in warm oceans

- If you feed a parrotfish with coral, it will drop you some white sand
- You can eat parrotfish but they are very poisonous
- 9 variants
